# 05 — Procedural Survivors (Kit)

Everyone in the colony who isn't a story character or a notable is assembled from this modular kit at runtime (game bible 07 — Colony Life-Sim). Every kit piece is skinned to **EXO_Humanoid** and deforms across the full height and build range via shared body morph targets. Budgets: Crowd tier (30k LOD0 per assembled survivor), max 4 influences.

**Assembly:** body preset → head (+ face morphs, skin tone) → hair / facial hair / headwear → outfit pieces by origin → accessories and marks → infection state.

## Bodies

| Piece | Description | Count | Asset pattern |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adult body | Base body with height (1.50–1.98 m) and build morphs (slim / average / athletic / broad / heavy) | 1 | `SK_NPC_Kit_BodyAdult` |
| Elder body | Stooped-posture base, age morphs, thinner skin detail | 1 | `SK_NPC_Kit_BodyElder` |
| Teen body | 13–17 proportions (teen profile), height 1.50–1.85 m | 1 | `SK_NPC_Kit_BodyTeen` |

## Rules

1. **Layering order:** skin → underlayer → top → outerwear → gear. Each layer hides the faces beneath it (hidden-face masks per piece) so layers never clip.
2. **One skeleton, one set of morphs.** Pieces are weighted to EXO_Humanoid and carry the same body morph targets (`body_slim`, `body_athletic`, `body_broad`, `body_heavy`, `age_older`).
3. **Palette-driven variety:** every outfit piece has 3 color masks recolored at runtime from the survivor's origin palette.
4. **Diversity by design:** the 48 heads, 40 hairstyles and 18 headwear pieces are reviewed together to cover a wide range of ancestries, ages and body types, without caricature.
5. **Child bodies** only use child-safe outfit pieces and never receive injury or infection states beyond Stage 1.
6. **Hollow conversion:** any adult kit survivor can be converted to a Hollow (chapter 06) by swapping to the Hollow material and adding Bloom attachments.

**Kit asset total:** 302 unique meshes.
